# A folder API rename must also update plain-object producers

The historical feed tree consumers switch to localizedName, but makeFolderObject still creates only a name field. Its returned children reach a comparator that calls localizedName.toLowerCase; an ordinary missing value can therefore throw when sorting compares such items. This is a plain tree item, not nsIMsgFolder. Fixed folder and feed factories now provide both fields. Later repair provenance and runtime reproduction remain gaps. Read the receiver and producer shape before a broad property rename.

Scope: Naming migrations and object contracts.
